name: AgentDojo (prompt-injection exfiltration)
description: A prompt injection planted in data the agent reads turns its own tools into the exfiltration path: the attack arrives on a tool_response, the secret leaves on a tool_call, and the answer shown to the user stays clean. Each scenario carries the exact stolen values as canaries, so it scores deterministically without an LLM tier.
attribution: Derived from AgentDojo by Debenedetti et al. (NeurIPS 2024 Datasets & Benchmarks), MIT-licensed. User tasks, injection goals and environments are the authors' data; trajectories were replayed against their environment and reshaped into AgentLeak traces.
